content: 1. If you are allergic to this medication or have any other allergies, inform your healthcare provider. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. 2. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if it is clearly necessary. It is not known whether this drug passes into breast milk, so consult your doctor before breastfeeding. 3. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. 4. This medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, such as phosphate level measurements, potentially leading to inaccurate test results. Inform your healthcare provider and laboratory personnel if you are using this medication. 5. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. 6. While using this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests (e.g., kidney and liver function, potassium and magnesium levels, complete blood counts) should be conducted regularly. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments. 7. It is crucial to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist promptly to establish a new dosing schedule. 8. For storage instructions, refer to the product guidelines and consult your pharmacist. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. 9. This information was last revised in May 2024. It is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. 10. Your list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the applicable plan provider for the most current information. 11. If you send this information to a recipient, they will receive further details and instructions to access the offer.
